footnote_text: On April 28, 2026, the Issuer effected a one-for-20 reverse stock split of its issued and outstanding common stock and made proportionate retroactive adjustments to its outstanding equity awards to the extent required including with respect to then-outstanding RSUs (the "Reverse Split"). No fractional shares were issued in connection with the Reverse Split, and each holder who otherwise would have been entitled to receive a fractional share received one whole share of common stock in lieu of such fractional share. Accordingly, the amount of securities beneficially owned directly and indirectly in column 5 of Table 1 has been adjusted to reflect the impact of the Reverse Split.

Except as otherwise disclosed above, Mr. Chan Chun Sing (i) directly holds 800,000 Class B Ordinary Shares; (ii) beneficially owns 327,047 Class B Ordinary Shares through his 100% ownership of Circuit Delight Limited; and (iii) is deemed to beneficially own 65,520 Class A Ordinary Shares by virtue of his spouse's 100% ownership of Classic Impact Limited.
